Collect all observability signals

span.p:
P-16: unaccompanied, non-responsive,
age unknown
→ non_assisted=true
→ age_inferred=true
→ communication_barrier=true
→ all flags set; Track C decides weight

div.style: color: rgb(170, 170, 170) !important; font-size: 11px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
These flags are
PASSED AS-IS to the risk model.
The risk model (Track C) applies
asymmetric reliability discounting.
Track A has no production rule
for 'this patient is unreliable'.
